primary_target.title: On the records and zeros of a deterministic random walk
primary_target.observed_status: The square-root-of-three four-phase record recurrence is described as experimental; the accompanying automaton is conditional on its validity.
primary_target.inspection: HTML full text and PDF page 7 screenshot inspected.
primary_target.attribution: The paper attributes the recurrence to Arias de Reyna and van de Lune and corrects a typo in its first line.

original_attribution.title: On some oscillating sums
original_attribution.inspection_limitation: Original attribution and bibliographic details follow Bruin and Fokkink; the corrected conjecture itself was checked in their paper, not reconstructed from the 2008 typesetting.

earlier_distinct_result.title: Fast computation of an alternating sum
earlier_distinct_result.note: The already known square-root-of-two record theorem is recalled by Bruin and Fokkink, Theorem 3; it is not claimed as new here.

limitations: This literature check does not certify absence of a separate proof elsewhere.
